newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks sink at open as golds fall.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks sink at open as golds fall.

text.p: * Toronto stocks fell at the open as the golds sector lost more than five percent on sliding bullion. * Trading was moderate, with 7.5 million shares traded worth C$75.5 million.
Toronto stocks held steady at their lower levels at midday on Monday as losses by golds and real estate were partly offset by stronger conglomerates and merchandising.

The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index fell 21.32 points to 6564.12 in turnover of 40.84 million shares worth C$627.71 million. Declining stocks outpaced advances 486 to 311, while 282 issues held steady.
The heavily weighted gold sub-index led ten sectors lower, shedding 377.39 points or 4.8 percent to 7477.81 on sliding bullion prices.
Real estate lost nearly one percent or 23.38 points to 2356.05.
Gaining sub-indexes included conglomerates, merchandising, banks and communications.
